title: Lyn Buchanan, army psychic spy behind The Men Who Stare at Goats

tellings.quote: Cassidy is based on a guy named Lynn Buchanan who's a famous kind of army psychic spy remote viewer, and I I just interviewed him.

plain: The character Cassidy in The Men Who Stare at Goats, a story about the US Army's psychic soldiers, is based on a real man named Lyn Buchanan, according to Jesse Michels. Michels describes Buchanan as a famous Army psychic spy and remote viewer, meaning someone trained to describe faraway places or targets using only the mind. Michels says he had just interviewed Buchanan himself, and he names a man called Albert Stubblebine alongside him, which would mean the Army really did run psychics as spies.
